findings.observation: The draft retains physical issuance and acceptance, prohibits mandatory digital enrollment and differential service conditions, and provides complaint and exception mechanisms.
findings.authority: Department, governmental entities and applicable service operators
findings.resolution_evidence: Representative service observations, matched service outcomes, accessible correction and complaint disposition.
findings.recommendation: Collect matched service evidence and investigate denial, compulsion and remedy before claiming equivalence.
findings.interpretation_boundary: Documentary proposition; constructed cases are not observed failures; proposed treatment authority is not an independently established acceptance authority.
findings.interpretation: These are meaningful design-level protections for format choice; documentary requirements and policy reviews cannot establish field-level equivalence, accessibility or remedy.
findings.design_protection: The physical-pathway and non-compulsion obligations directly address the stated exclusion mechanism at the requirement level.

findings.observation: BOR-08 requires cryptographic hiding of unselected attributes; SDI-07 permits structural or cryptographic mechanisms, and CRY-03 excludes field filtering alone. Other cited requirements constrain disclosure and request context.
findings.authority: SEDI specification owners; wallet, verifier and relying-party implementers
findings.resolution_evidence: Clarify combined requirements; independently examine actual cryptographic construction, purpose and recipient binding, negative disclosure and metadata tests.
findings.recommendation: Assess combined disclosure and request-context protections with cryptographic and metadata tests; clarify ambiguous specification requirements where necessary.
findings.interpretation_boundary: Documentary proposition; constructed cases are not observed failures; proposed treatment authority is not an independently established acceptance authority.
findings.interpretation: Read these requirements jointly: an individually valid field selection or predicate is not proof of hiding or unlinkability across the actual request, recipient and metadata.
findings.design_protection: The explicit attribute-choice, hiding and predicate constraints address over-disclosure at design level, subject to compatible implementation.

findings.observation: The cited rights, privacy, wallet, organizational and audit requirements restrict monitoring and address presentation history and security records.
findings.resolution_evidence: Log and telemetry data flows, access, integrity and instrumentation evidence without holder-identifying presentation history.
findings.recommendation: Examine log content, visibility and access jointly with anti-surveillance restrictions.
findings.interpretation_boundary: Documentary proposition; constructed cases are not observed failures; proposed treatment authority is not an independently established acceptance authority.
findings.interpretation: Log content, access and completeness must be considered together. Neither logging nor its absence alone establishes accountability without surveillance.
findings.design_protection: The explicit anti-monitoring and restricted-history requirements address presentation tracking; security logging and audit obligations address accountability.

findings.observation: The cited lifecycle requirements address status, offline presentation, replacement, migration, revocation, rotation and compromise response.
findings.resolution_evidence: Status staleness policy, propagation, recovery, migration, emergency key transitions and continuity evidence.
findings.recommendation: Test status freshness, recovery, migration and key transitions together; document tolerable staleness and residual exposure.
findings.interpretation_boundary: Documentary proposition; constructed cases are not observed failures; proposed treatment authority is not an independently established acceptance authority.
findings.interpretation: Separate lifecycle controls do not establish that stale status, recovery, migration and key changes compose safely in a real interaction.
findings.design_protection: Revocation, replacement and portability obligations, plus rotation continuity, directly address compromise and lockout risks in design.

findings.observation: The cited application, holder-control, guardian-presentation and loyalty requirements address identity and representative authorization, bounded actions and duties toward individuals.
findings.resolution_evidence: Relationship and appointment evidence, scoped authority, termination, attribution, factual grounds and accessible challenge.
findings.recommendation: Validate current appointment, scope, termination and actual grounds; provide accessible challenge and oversight.
findings.interpretation_boundary: Documentary proposition; constructed cases are not observed failures; proposed treatment authority is not an independently established acceptance authority.
findings.interpretation: Identity, current authority, action scope and factual justification are distinct; technically authorized exercise can still harm the person represented.
findings.design_protection: The express guardian-authorization, expiry, scope and loyalty provisions address unauthorized and exploitative representation at design level.

findings.observation: The cited program, interoperability and organizational requirements address conformance assessment, open standards, common formats and change management.
findings.resolution_evidence: Version-bound paired interaction evidence, applicable role and method coverage, change-impact and reassessment records.
findings.recommendation: Require version-bound interaction evidence rather than aggregate component pass results.
findings.interpretation_boundary: Documentary proposition; constructed cases are not observed failures; proposed treatment authority is not an independently established acceptance authority.
findings.interpretation: Individual component or profile conformance cannot establish end-to-end interaction properties, especially with mismatched versions or changed configuration.
findings.design_protection: The independent assessment, interoperability and change-management provisions provide useful component-level protections and evidence expectations.

findings.observation: The cited application and proofing requirements address eligibility, risk-commensurate proofing, authoritative inputs, accessible methods and authorized proofing entities.
findings.resolution_evidence: Approved proofing criteria, authoritative inputs, proportionality, correction and representative accessibility evidence.
findings.recommendation: Examine approved proofing criteria, authoritative inputs and correction pathways with affected participants.
findings.interpretation_boundary: Documentary proposition; constructed cases are not observed failures; proposed treatment authority is not an independently established acceptance authority.
findings.interpretation: The age gate and guardian pathways must be interpreted jointly. A nominal proofing level or four populated assertion fields cannot establish accurate or proportionate proofing.
findings.design_protection: The accepted-standard, risk-commensurate and alternative-method provisions directly address proofing quality and exclusion in design.

findings.observation: The cited processing, wallet, verifier and relying-party requirements constrain purposes, collection, consent, retention and onward disclosure.
findings.resolution_evidence: Data lineage, purpose and legal basis, consent scope, retention/deletion and downstream access evidence.
findings.recommendation: Trace purpose, authorization, retention and onward disclosure rather than treating consent as sufficient.
findings.interpretation_boundary: Documentary proposition; constructed cases are not observed failures; proposed treatment authority is not an independently established acceptance authority.
findings.interpretation: A later consent record or a passing local prompt does not establish that the original purpose, recipient and other processing restrictions are satisfied across actors.
findings.design_protection: The explicit purpose, per-transaction consent and retention restrictions address secondary processing at the requirement level.

findings.observation: The cited authenticity, key and infrastructure requirements address cryptographic verification, Department control and third-party compliance.
findings.resolution_evidence: Key provenance, actual custody and control, ceremony and delegated function scope; clarify combined SDI-13, KMS-03 and ORG-06 obligations.
findings.recommendation: Obtain independent evidence of key custody and actual institutional control; clarify delegated functions.
findings.interpretation_boundary: Documentary proposition; constructed cases are not observed failures; proposed treatment authority is not an independently established acceptance authority.
findings.interpretation: Signature validity, actual key provenance, institutional custody and scope of delegated operations require distinct evidence; delegated custody examples do not themselves authorize relinquishing control.
findings.design_protection: The provenance, key-management and Department-control obligations provide design-level protections against forged issuance and unauthorized custody.

findings.observation: INT-01, CRY-04 and ORG-04 include method declarations whose limitations refer to expert or organizational examination; KMS-04 has a similar EXPT issue and INT-04 omits ADMN.
findings.resolution_evidence: Publisher clarification of applicability and intended assessment objects.
findings.recommendation: Ask guide maintainers to clarify method declarations and limitations without silently modifying source assignments.
findings.interpretation_boundary: Documentary proposition; constructed cases are not observed failures; proposed treatment authority is not an independently established acceptance authority.

findings.interpretation: Treat the source-declared method and its limitation separately. The apparent tensions require guide-maintainer clarification, not silent reassignment of methods.
findings.design_protection: The guide exposes method limitations and explicit objective mappings; these make the clarification needs visible without resolving them.

findings.observation: The cited program and acceptance requirements address public consultation, response, profile approval and actor-specific acceptance obligations.
findings.resolution_evidence: Approval docket, role applicability and exception basis.
findings.recommendation: Verify the applicable approval and exception basis independently of technical suitability.
findings.interpretation_boundary: Documentary proposition; constructed cases are not observed failures; proposed treatment authority is not an independently established acceptance authority.
findings.interpretation: Technical suitability is distinct from lawful approval and the scope of an actor-specific obligation or exception.
findings.design_protection: The express consultation, response and actor-specific acceptance obligations provide procedural and scope protections in design.

findings.observation: IDP-08 appears in the retained index and annex mappings, but no detailed numbered objective or method section was located in Part 3.
findings.resolution_evidence: Publisher-qualified detailed requirement or explicit disposition of the source omission.
findings.recommendation: Request missing detailed IDP-08 text or explicit publisher disposition.
findings.interpretation_boundary: Documentary proposition; constructed cases are not observed failures; proposed treatment authority is not an independently established acceptance authority.
findings.interpretation: The source omission prevents a complete requirement-level examination. APP-08 is a distinct requirement and cannot substitute for IDP-08.
findings.design_protection: Independence is identified as a protection in the summary material, but the detailed protection and assessment criteria are not established.
